task: Who is the parent company of Old Navy?

merged.claim: Gap Inc. is the parent company of Old Navy.

variants.A: Old Navy's parent company is Gap Inc.
variants.B: Gap Inc. is the parent company of Old Navy; Old Navy is a division of Gap Inc.
variants.C: Gap Inc. is the parent company of Old Navy; Old Navy is one of Gap Inc.'s brands.
variants.D: Old Navy's parent company is Gap Inc. (The Gap, Inc.).
variants.E: Old Navy's parent company is Gap Inc.
variants.F: Gap Inc. is the parent company of Old Navy.

merged.claim: Gap Inc.'s brands are Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta.

variants.A: Gap Inc.'s brand portfolio includes Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta.
variants.D: Old Navy is one of Gap Inc.'s four brands, alongside Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta.
variants.E: Gap Inc.'s corporate website identifies Old Navy as one of its four brands: Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta.
variants.F: Gap Inc. owns four brands: Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta.

merged.claim: Gap Inc.'s annual filing for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 describes it as a house of iconic American brands offering apparel, accessories and personal care products for men, women and children under the Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta brands.

variants.C: Gap Inc.'s annual filing for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 describes Gap Inc. as a house of iconic American brands offering apparel, accessories, and personal care products for men, women, and children under the Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta brands.

merged.claim: Gap Inc.'s corporate website (as of 2026-11-05) presents Old Navy within its house of iconic American brands.

variants.C: Gap Inc.'s corporate website (as of 2026-11-05) presents Old Navy within its house of iconic American brands.

merged.claim: Old Navy was founded in 1994 as part of (a division of) Gap Inc.

variants.B: Old Navy was founded in 1994 as a division of Gap Inc.
variants.E: Old Navy was founded in 1994 as part of San Francisco-based Gap Inc.

merged.claim: Gap Inc. is listed on the NYSE under the ticker GAP.

variants.E: Gap Inc. is listed on the NYSE under the ticker GAP.

merged.claim: Gap Inc. planned a spin-off of Old Navy in 2019 but abandoned the plan in 2020, so ownership has not changed.

variants.D: Gap Inc. planned a spin-off of Old Navy in 2019 but abandoned the plan in 2020, so ownership has not changed.

merged.claim: The Wikipedia infobox for Old Navy lists its parent as Gap Inc. (1993–present).

variants.D: The Wikipedia infobox for Old Navy lists its parent as Gap Inc. (1993–present).

merged.claim: Old Navy has corporate operations in the Mission Bay neighborhood of San Francisco, California.

variants.D: Old Navy has corporate operations in the Mission Bay neighborhood of San Francisco, California.

merged.claim: Old Navy's largest stores are its flagship stores in New York City, Manila and Mexico City.

variants.D: Old Navy's largest stores are its flagship stores in New York City, Manila and Mexico City.

merged.claim: Old Navy was founded in 1994, is a global apparel and accessories brand headquartered in San Francisco, and is owned by Gap Inc., one of the largest apparel companies in the US.

variants.D: Old Navy was founded in 1994, is a global apparel and accessories brand headquartered in San Francisco, and is owned by Gap Inc., one of the largest apparel companies in the US.

merged.claim: Old Navy operates more than 1,200 stores across the United States and Canada, as well as franchise locations around the world.

variants.E: Old Navy operates more than 1,200 stores across the United States and Canada, as well as franchise locations around the world.

merged.claim: oldnavy.com redirects (301 permanent redirect) to oldnavy.gap.com, which is on Gap's own domain.

variants.F: oldnavy.com redirects (301 permanent redirect) to oldnavy.gap.com, which is on Gap's own domain.

merged.claim: Gap Inc. (the parent, NYSE: GAP) is distinct from Gap, the clothing brand of the same name; Gap is a sister brand to Old Navy, not its parent.

variants.F: Gap Inc. (the parent, NYSE: GAP) is distinct from Gap, the clothing brand of the same name; Gap is a sister brand to Old Navy, not its parent.

c1.note: Gap Inc. 10-K and corporate site list Old Navy as a Gap Inc. brand; all variants A-F are equivalent and correct.

c3.note: Gap Inc. site lists four brands: Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, Athleta, matching the 10-K.

c4.note: 10-K text quoted verbatim matches the claim.

c5.note: Gap Inc. site describes four iconic American brands including Old Navy; the 'as of 2026-11-05' date is not shown but the page is current.

c6.note: Gap Inc. boilerplate says 'Founded in 1994 as a division of' / 'as part of' Gap Inc.

c8.note: Gap Inc. site shows NYSE: GAP as of Nov 11, 2026.

c11.note: Spin-off announced Feb 2019 and called off Jan 16, 2020; the 2026 10-K still lists Old Navy as a Gap brand.

c13.note: Wikipedia infobox shows Parent: Gap Inc. (1993–present).

c15.note: Wikipedia states corporate operations are in Mission Bay, San Francisco.

c16.note: Wikipedia states the largest Old Navy stores are the flagships in New York City, Manila and Mexico City; this is trivia, not about the parent company.

c18.note: Business of Fashion states Old Navy was founded in 1994, is headquartered in San Francisco and is owned by parent Gap Inc.

c20.note: A Nov 2026 Gap Inc. press release boilerplate gives more than 1,200 stores in the US and Canada plus franchises, and says it was founded as a division of Gap Inc.

c22.note: oldnavy.com content links to oldnavy.gap.com, and its header lists the sister brands. The 301 status code is not directly shown, but the redirect to Gap's domain is consistent.

c23.note: Gap Inc. lists Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta as its four brands, so Gap is a sister brand and Gap Inc. is the parent.

c1.note: Gap Inc.'s site and Wikipedia both name Gap Inc. as Old Navy's parent. Gap Inc.'s Sept 2026 Old Navy Sport article calls Old Navy a division of Gap Inc.

c3.note: Gap Inc.'s About page lists four brands: Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta.

c4.note: The 10-K for the fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026 uses the 'house of iconic American brands' wording for these four brands. I checked the description quote but not the brand list in the 10-K text; it matches the About page.

c12.note: The 10-K for the fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026 lists Old Navy as a Gap Inc. brand. The filing date wasn't shown, but the forward-looking statements are dated March 17, 2026, which fits the claimed date.

c15.note: The Wikipedia Old Navy article says it has corporate operations in the Mission Bay neighborhood of San Francisco.
